description: This file defines interfaces and classes for managing Resource Element (RE) buffers in a wireless communication system, including read-only, read-write, static, dynamic, and modular buffer implementations, with support for views and slicing.

classes.name: re_buffer_dimensions
classes.description: Interface for accessing the dimension sizes of a Resource Element buffer.

classes.name: re_buffer_reader
classes.description: Read-only interface for Resource Element buffers, templated by resource element type.

classes.name: re_buffer_writer
classes.description: Read-write interface for Resource Element buffers, templated by resource element type.

classes.name: re_buffer_reader_view
classes.description: Read-only view class providing subspan access to RE buffers.

classes.name: re_buffer_writer_view
classes.description: Writeable view class providing subspan access to RE buffers.

classes.name: dynamic_re_buffer
classes.description: Resizable, dynamic implementation of RE buffer using tensors.

classes.name: static_re_buffer
classes.description: Fixed-size, static implementation of RE buffer with maximum dimensions.

classes.name: modular_re_buffer_reader
classes.description: External view to contiguous RE blocks, with settable slices.

classes.name: modular_re_buffer
classes.description: External view to contiguous RE blocks, with dynamic resizing and copying capabilities.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resize buffer to specified number of slices and resource elements.

methods.name: get_slice
methods.description: Retrieve a span of resource elements for a specific slice.

methods.name: set_slice
methods.description: Set the view for a specific slice in modular buffers.
